# vMLX 1.6.59

## Changes

- Preserve image and video attachments when editing saved chat messages, avoid reprocessing media on every keystroke, and stop cleanly if history truncation fails.
- Preserve streamed Responses reasoning around tool-call buffering. Error-only terminal events no longer count as generated tokens; context errors distinguish input and output budgets.
- Show SSD capacity notices and Clear SSD Cache controls in the active Chat view. Refused writes no longer claim durable storage, and prefix coverage reflects the state actually published.
- Upgrade the desktop runtime to Electron 44.3.0 and the SQLite binding to 13.0.3. Await asynchronous native clipboard operations and preserve existing database schemas, saved chats, and explicit session settings.
- Derive Qwen media positions from complete vision blocks. Numerical and sparse-prefill experiments remain opt-in.

## Scope and limitations

This is a qualified maintenance release, not an all-model performance or compatibility certification. Independent-provider native Responses and opaque-reasoning history remain unqualified; the public provider checked supports Chat tools but not Responses. No universal speedup, autoregressive speed floor, one-million-token inference, or identical factual output across quantizations is promised. Previously documented model-quality and multimodal-cache limitations remain. Dependency advisories remain under review; this release is not an advisory-free certification.
